def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a single path component with no separators, drive prefix, or parent reference."""
    ex is_plain_name("notes.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../secret.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name or ":" in name:
        return False
    return True

def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Return the text of the first name in names that can be read from the notes directory, or "" when none can.

    Each name is untrusted. Only names that pass is_plain_name are opened, and they are opened
    through a capability narrowed with fs.sub("notes"), so nothing outside notes is reachable.
    Missing or unreadable files are skipped.
    """
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        for name in names:
            if not is_plain_name(name):
                continue
            text = fs.read_text(name) else ""
            if text != "":
                return text
    return ""
